text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Tuesday (only two newspapers were published). Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Lebanon will issue within the coming few days a Eurobond worth $100 million to be used by the public electric utility.
-The pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army militia released seven detainees from Khiam prison in Israel's occupation zone in south Lebanon.
-Prime Minister Hariri will meet French President Chirac in Paris on Tuesday.
-Foreign Minister Bouez said there will not be peace in the region except on the basis the land-for-peace formula set at the 1991 Madrid conference.
